title: P2CS Event Envelope
description: Standardised wrapper for every inter-stage P2CS event. Provides identity, timing, provenance linkage, and a typed payload. Every event wrapped in this envelope is fully replayable.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of event emission

producer.description: AIOL module ID of the stage that emitted this event (e.g. p2cs.discovery)

artifact_hash.description: SHA-256 of the serialised payload, enabling replay integrity checks

parent_hash.description: artifact_hash of the upstream event that triggered this one; null for root events

parent_event_id.description: id of the upstream event that triggered this one; null for root events

provenance.description: Artifact ID of the ProvenanceManifest associated with this event's payload; null until provenance stage runs

payload_type.description: Fully qualified contract type name of the payload (e.g. PublicationManifest)

payload.description: The event payload; must conform to the schema identified by payload_type
